formulaDefinitions.D: mean coil diameter = inner diameter + wire diameter
formulaDefinitions.N_a: active-coil count; manual reported coil number is treated as N_a, with N_a-1 as a bounded interpretation

importantBoundary: These are derived coil rates, not factory force-displacement curves and not wheel rates. Motion ratio, spring seat angle, preload, bump stop and nonlinear end-coil behavior remain missing.
reproducibility: All dimensions are transcribed from R-4 of the byte-preserved workshop bundle; the numerical calculation uses SI units and the stated G assumption. Recompute only if the source page or active-coil interpretation changes.
